page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut printer's device (an oval cartouche with a figure at a mountain and hammer, flanked by female figures and ornament) in the centre of the page. The ring inscription runs round the oval. No other printed text. The strip at the right edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
page.notes: Woodcut printer's device: an oval cartouche with a miner or smith at a rock, hammer raised, flanked by two standing female figures, with a head at the base and a scrolled and floral frame. The inscription runs round the oval: "SEBASTIAN · HEINRIC" on the right side and "PETRI" on the left, the lower part of the ring is partly obscured by the ornament. Faint mirrored show-through near the top of the page is not transcribed. The vertical strip at the right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
